## Frequently asked questions

### What is DeepSeek V4.1 Flash?

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is an open-weight, multimodal Mixture-of-Experts AI model released by DeepSeek on September 10, 2026, under an MIT license. It has a 552-billion-parameter backbone with 8 billion active parameters during prefill and 16 billion during decoding, a 1-million-token context window, and native image-and-text processing.
